comments.author: @alwaysemployed656
comments.text:
FedEx driver here. There are a lot of misconceptions, usually coming from nobodies trying to be somebodies.

The two drivers who were let go could have minded their own business instead of standing up for others. Their attempt to stand up for others resulted in conflicts, and that's why they were let go. Deliver your packages and go home.

As for the merger, Express has been the least important division for more than ten years. This is not the first time Express has been discussed as a division that could be dissolved. Now it's a done deal.

Express is no longer in high enough demand to justify operating as a separate division, so it's being phased out. One reason is that many people have gone paperless, which has reduced the volume of physical documents being shipped.
